enableAutoTracking.name: Auto-disengage on movement
enableAutoTracking.hint: If enabled, tokens that move further than the disengage distance from an engaged opponent automatically lose that engagement. Disable if you prefer purely manual control.

autoDisengageDistance.name: Minimum auto-disengage distance (yards)
autoDisengageDistance.hint: Floor for the auto-disengage threshold. The actual threshold is the maximum of this value and the longer of the two combatants' equipped weapon reaches (Very Long = 4 yds, Massive = 6 yds, all others = 2 yds per Core p.297). Default 2 yards.

debug.name: Debug logging
debug.hint: Log engagement state changes and outnumbering calculations to the console.
